raw_reconstruction.source: independent decode of frozen M40 support planes plus M72 centers plus independently rebuilt widths from M41 INT8 weights

schedule_comparison.interpretation: The residual error is numerically small and the abstract bound remains above 2x, but it invalidates the r2 claim that the current M106 controller edge recurrence has been fully modeled.

targeted_commercial_vcs_trace.scenario: descriptor 1 is empty with PWP=0 and closes while descriptor 0 drains four service tokens
targeted_commercial_vcs_trace.conclusion: Frozen M106 enforces prior-drain completion followed by a distinct in-order dispatch edge. The trace confirms the recurrence counterexample but is not a full PWP/accumulator combined-controller miter.

closed_parts: fill close to READY dispatch edge fill_end+1
m107_p0_closure.effect: empty and zero-PWP descriptors can be released or begin correction before the preceding M106 descriptor is actually retired

findings.finding: The r2 recurrence computes dispatch_ready as fill_end+1 without a separate prior M106 drain/release dependency. Independent raw replay increases candidate cycles by 25748, and a frozen-RTL VCS counterexample observes five close-to-release cycles where the fill-only rule predicts one.
findings.required_action: Issue r3 with a separate controller_free timeline: dispatch_edge=max(fill_end, controller_free)+1; set controller_free/bank_free to correction_end or the empty dispatch edge; rerun exact raw replay and freeze the corrected 521264186-cycle reference if unchanged.

findings.finding: The new VCS trace proves the controller counterexample only. There is still no commercial miter combining M106 ready/valid, per-descriptor PWP arbitration, signed accumulator handshakes, global flush, and commit.
findings.required_action: Build a small integrated RTL/reference trace spanning nonempty, empty, zero-PWP, bank-blocked, and commit-boundary descriptors before cycle-exact admission.

findings.finding: The schedule assumes one 96-lane signed24 update each cycle: a 2304-bit vector read plus write contract over 147456 bytes. No macro RDW/latency, epoch clear, commit collision, forwarding, or full-lane finite-width equivalence is proven.
findings.required_action: Select a realizable banked SRAM/register-file organization, replay its latency and hazards, and run exact signed24 final-state comparison against the integer reference.

findings.finding: PWP beats and M104 tokens are serialized abstractly, but shared weight/PWP payload addresses, bank conflicts, read latency, and arbitration are absent.
findings.required_action: Freeze the weight-memory map and replay address/port/latency contention on the ordered descriptor digest.

findings.finding: Both PWP requests and correction descriptors are assumed losslessly precompacted and available independently at descriptor fill start; scan, queue capacity, and delivery bandwidth are excluded.
findings.required_action: Keep the ratio labeled precompacted service island, or add a bounded precompaction/queue/bandwidth schedule.

findings.finding: The 2.13877x corrected value covers four heldout H67 bottleneck Conv3x3 operators at an assumed common clock. Macro-inclusive DC/PTPX, equal-area normalization, other network operators, and end-to-end delivery are absent.
findings.required_action: Do not use the value as physical, full-network, end-to-end, or headline speedup.

findings.finding: The fixed8 denominator is independently reproducible as 371461096 raw events times three service tokens plus the common tail, but it has no matched descriptor-ingress/controller edge schedule. This omission is conservative for the candidate ratio yet prevents a complete like-for-like controller comparison.
findings.suggested_action: Add a matched baseline controller schedule or retain the explicit service-token denominator label.

findings.finding: The producer result does not freeze a compact ordered descriptor digest or per-record schedule receipt; the independent audit supplies digest a011720a..., but it is not part of the r2 contract.
findings.suggested_action: Include the ordered digest and compact per-record counters in r3.

headroom_and_risk.assessment: The abstract schedule has materially better 2x headroom than M107, but it is not robust to a frequent extra accumulator or memory cycle.
